title: Willkommens-Merkel, Chaos-Johnson, and Tore-Klose: Modeling the Evaluative Meaning of German Personal Name Compounds
reasoning: The paper is a computational and linguistic study focusing on the evaluative meaning (valence) of personal name compounds in German. While it includes an ethics statement and uses sentiment analysis as a proxy for evaluation, it does not specifically benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
